name: EPIC 248841800
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 14, 13.9 solar radii and 1.08 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248841800 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.937135 (16th-84th percentiles 13.168618-14.748647), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248841800 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.081774 (16th-84th percentiles 0.951658-1.227246), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248841800: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4528.4062 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 248841800 (K2 campaign 14): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 5159.765625 (16th-84th percentiles 4938.125-5385.078125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 5,160 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 1.08 solar masses and 13.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,528 K at its surface.
